title: An invoice assistant for a non-technical owner
intro: This is a personal assistant built for a small business owner who isn't technical. Every evening it reads the day's email, picks out the invoices for the business and sends the owner a numbered list on WhatsApp. Nothing goes to the accountant until the owner replies yes to that exact list.
disclaimer: A working re-creation. Henrique (made up), Atelier Sol Poente (made up), the accountant, the suppliers and the emails are all made up, and nothing is sent.
role: Each evening it lists the new invoices in one person's inbox, and sends them to the accountant only after that person replies yes.
